title: The Legend of Kuchisake Onna

scenes.narration: Your answer decides whether you live or die the moment she asks if she is pretty.
This is Kuchisake Onna, haunting quiet towns as the slit mouthed woman of ancient Japanese folklore.
A terrified pedestrian who answers no gets struck instantly with heavy iron medical scissors.
Saying yes causes her to pull down the mask slowly, revealing a horrifying mouth slit from ear to ear.
She asks the exact same terrifying question again, and screaming guarantees a fatal cut from her heavy weapon.
Village tradition holds that smart survivors escape by carefully describing her appearance as merely average today.
Throwing hard caramel candy or heavy coins buys enough precious time to run away very safely.
What exact words would you choose first if she suddenly stopped you alone in the dark fog?
